capabilities.title: Bitwarden-compatible REST API for vault sync across clients
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Vaultwarden: implements the full Bitwarden server API for client compatibility
capabilities.reason: Nexus is not a password vault server. Running a Bitwarden-compatible API is outside product scope.

capabilities.title: End-to-end client-side encryption before vault sync
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Vaultwarden supplies a compatible server while encryption is performed by official clients; current Bitwarden documentation records PBKDF2 HMAC-SHA-256 at 600,000 client iterations as the default/minimum PBKDF2 work factor.
capabilities.reason: Nexus implements an original, browser-local sealed-notes envelope with PBKDF2-SHA-256, AES-GCM-256, strict validation, fresh salt and IV per seal, manual and automatic locking, full note mutation, passphrase change, and encrypted import/export. It is intentionally not Bitwarden-compatible or a synced end-to-end vault.

capabilities.title: Self-hosted Rust password vault server with SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL support
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Vaultwarden: lightweight Rust reimplementation of Bitwarden server
capabilities.reason: Nexus is a Next.js dashboard and does not need a separate password server process.

capabilities.title: Shared organization vaults with role-based access control
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Vaultwarden organizations: team vault sharing with admin/manager/member roles
capabilities.reason: Nexus is a personal intelligence tool; organization vault sharing is out of scope.
